meta_title: Paul Wade Painting & Decorating | Nottingham Painter
meta_description: Paul Wade Painting and Decorating in Nottingham. Interior and exterior painting, decorating, and specialist finishes. Free quotes, reliable local service.
hero_subhead: From a single room refresh to a full house makeover, we deliver quality finishes on time and on budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: Whether you need interior refreshes, exterior repaints, or specialist finishes, we've got you covered.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Full interior redecoration including wallpapering, emulsion, and feature walls. We prepare surfaces properly so your finish lasts years, not months.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior repaints using premium masonry and gloss paints. We protect your property and refresh its kerb appeal in one go.

services.title: Woodwork & Gloss Finishing
services.desc: Doors, windows, skirting boards, and fascias painted to a professional finish. Hand-applied gloss gives a durable, smart look that outlasts spray finishes.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Bold colour choices made to work. We help you choose the right shade and create dramatic focal points that transform a room.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging with proper pattern matching and seam finishing. Old paper removed carefully to leave walls ready for new decoration.

services.title: Surface Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: We never cut corners on prep — filling, sanding, and treating damp or problem areas so your final finish is flawless and long-lasting.

about_pullquote: I do the work myself because I stand behind every job. No shortcuts, no excuses.
about_para_1: Paul Wade Painting and Decorating has served Nottingham homeowners and businesses for over 15 years. What started as a one-man operation has grown through word of mouth and repeat customers who trust us to refresh their homes year after year. Paul still turns up to every job himself, ensuring the same high standard you'd expect from day one.
about_para_2: We're known locally for honest pricing, neat workmanship, and turning up when we say we will. Most of our new customers come from referrals because we treat every room — whether it's a bedsit or a five-bedroom house — with the same care and attention. Your home is important to you. It matters to us too.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Paul came to do our lounge and hallway. First time we've had a decorator who actually prepares the surfaces properly — he spent nearly a full day on prep before painting started. The finish is immaculate. Will absolutely use him again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: We were dreading redecorating our daughter's bedroom but Paul made the whole thing painless. He suggested a feature wall we wouldn't have thought of, finished on time, and left the place spotless. Fair price too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jennifer P.

reviews.text: Called Paul for an external repaint and a bit of woodwork on the fascia. He quoted quickly, got the job done in two days, and honestly the house looks years younger. Professional bloke, reliable, and doesn't disappear halfway through the job.
reviews.author: David K.
